name: New Hampshire

default_limits.basis: RSA 265:60 II: 30 business/urban residence district, 35 rural residence district, 45 unimproved rural highway, 55 other, 65 interstate (70 on I-93 MM45 to VT line)

fine.notes: Statutory fines (RSA 265:60 V) for non-interstate limits. On 65 mph interstates: 1-5 $65, 6-10 $100, 11-15 $150, 16-20 $250, 21+ $350. On 70 mph I-93: 1-5 $65, 6-10 $100, 11-15 $200, 16-20 $300, 21+ $400. All plus penalty assessment.

court_costs.notes: No fixed court cost; a penalty assessment of 24% of the fine (min $2) is added (RSA 106-L:10).

points.notes: DMV: under 25 over = 3 pts, 25+ over = 4. Reckless = 6. Age 21+: 12 pts/1 yr can suspend up to 3 months.

zones.work_zone: Limit is at least 10 mph below posted in active work zones (RSA 265:60 II).
zones.school_zone: Limit is 10 mph below posted around school opening/closing (RSA 265:60 II).

court.reason: Top fine bracket ($350) and 4 points; 25+ over is the DMV's higher point tier.

sources.title: RSA 265:60 Basic speed limits and fines
RSA 265:79 Reckless operation (100 mph paragraph II)

notes: 100+ mph tier: RSA 265:79 II (eff. 1/1/2026, 2025 ch. 71/278) = min $750 + PA, 90-day revocation, no stated max fine. It is a 'violation', not a crime: no jail, though police may still take custody; not verified. Points at exactly 25 over: DMV wording ('under 25' / '25 or more') used. Residential default is 30 urban, 35 rural residence. Interstate 65 is posted max.
